t: This is the site associated with Elliott and Fry, a Victorian photography studio founded in 1863 by two photographers, Joseph John Elliott and Clarence Edmund Fry. For about a century, the firm took and published photographs of the public, and of the social, artistic, scientific and political figures of the day. By the 1880s it ran three studios, four large stores for negatives, and a printing works at Barnet. Think of it as a portrait factory for Victorian celebrity, started by these two partners.
